create_MpiSintel_dataset: create a MpiSintelClean or MpiSintelFinal PyTorch dataset for MPI Sintel optical flow training data
create_FlyingChairs_dataset: create a FlyingChairs PyTorch dataset that loads .ppm image pairs and .flo flow files
create_FlyingThings_dataset: create a FlyingThingsClean or FlyingThingsFinal dataset for FlyingThings3D stereo optical flow data
